headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 win behind a strong performance from Jesús Luzardo. Alec Bohm led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the Washington Nationals secured a 6-4 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Paxton Schultz earning the win and Gus Varland notching the save. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Boston Red Sox 6-1, with Dylan Cease earning the win after 5.0 IP of work. The New York Yankees routed the Chicago White Sox 12-2, with José Caballero leading the White Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Will Wilson has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the Seattle Mariners. Randy Arozarena, also of the Mariners, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Brad Keller has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Philadelphia Phillies due to right forearm tendinitis. Other players on the injured list include Daniel Palencia (Chicago Cubs), Angel Martínez (Cleveland Guardians), Corey Seager (Texas Rangers), Grayson Rodriguez (Los Angeles Angels), and Jorge Polanco (New York Mets).

Several roster moves have been made in the past 24 hours. The Kansas City Royals acquired Connor Seabold in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays, sending RHP Denis Samudio and cash in return. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash. The Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Cruise Past Marlins in 8-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 win behind a strong performance from Jesús Luzardo, who earned the win with 7.0 innings pitched, 9 strikeouts, 2 earned runs, and 2 walks. Alec Bohm led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Royals 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 4-6 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Paxton Schultz earning the win and Gus Varland notching the save. Curtis Mead led the Royals' offense with a 1-for-3 performance, including a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Cease earning the win after 5.0 IP of work.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout White Sox 12-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 12-2 victory. José Caballero led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Place Will Wilson on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have made a roster move, placing third baseman Will Wilson on the 60-day injured list. This change is effective as of June 16, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Connor Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their roster, trading RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold.
